core_coverage.answer_quote: When Rebirth is available, fatal damage turns Anivia into an egg.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both availability and the fatal-damage transformation.

core_coverage.answer_quote: She revives if the egg survives for a few seconds.
core_coverage.reason: Makes revival conditional on egg survival.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Anivia launches an ice projectile that damages and slows enemies along its path.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the projectile's path damage and slow.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Its explosion damages and stuns nearby enemies.
core_coverage.reason: Assigns the area damage and stun to the explosion.

core_coverage.answer_quote: She can recast during flight to explode it early; otherwise, it explodes at maximum range.
core_coverage.reason: Explains manual early detonation and automatic maximum-range detonation.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Anivia creates a temporary ice wall that blocks movement through its terrain.
core_coverage.reason: Explains movement-blocking terrain without claiming every movement ability is prevented from crossing.

core_coverage.answer_quote: The wall melts after a short time.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly explains that the wall expires.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Anivia deals magic damage to a targeted enemy.
The damage doubles if the enemy was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both qualifying sources and retains the fully formed storm requirement.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Anivia toggles a persistent storm at a chosen location that repeatedly damages and slows enemies inside.
core_coverage.reason: Explains a toggled storm placed at a chosen location; persistence does not explicitly promise immunity to interruption.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Anivia toggles a persistent storm at a chosen location that repeatedly damages and slows enemies inside.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly describes repeated damage and slowing within the area.

core_coverage.answer_quote: The storm grows after activation, dealing more damage and applying a stronger slow at full size.
core_coverage.reason: Explains growth and both full-size enhancements.

conflicts.resolution: Completed revival at full health remains unresolved: Riot's summary says full health, while the detailed Wiki distinguishes initial restoration from current health at revival. The draft correctly avoids guaranteeing completion health.
Use Riot and the detailed Wiki requirement of a fully formed storm. The abbreviated Wiki statement omits this condition; the draft retains it.
Prefer the detailed distance, mana and cast-inhibiting crowd-control rules over the abbreviated interruption summary. The draft makes no universal interruption claim.

factual_risks: This is a text evidence support check, not human approval or visual verification; all six drafts remain unapproved.
The passive visual description is mechanically supported, but its appearance and current-client accuracy are not verified.
Frostbite's qualifying mark must still exist at impact. The draft's general recent-hit explanation is supported and does not guarantee bonus damage from cast-time qualification.
Storm persistence is conditional on distance, mana and interruption rules. Their omission is acceptable introductory simplification, not evidence of unconditional persistence.
Crystallize knockback speed remains explicitly unverified; no draft claim depends on it.
Evidence is frozen to the supplied versions and does not establish current-patch accuracy.
Counterplay and priorities are reasonable mechanic-grounded inferences. No visible inference, confidence or development labels appear in the learning text.
